product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides freight forwarding, customs brokerage, domestic transportation and trade-compliance consulting for businesses managing international and North American supply chains.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing/plans page was found; services are quoted individually, and the Rates page is an image attachment rather than a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The readable article indexes cover trade regulations, logistics, customer stories and corporate news, not engineer-authored accounts of product architecture or infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Public trade resources and individual GlobalLink feature/how-to articles exist, but no public product-documentation site, multi-article help center or developer portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable company job board listed logistics, customs, accounting and sales positions; none had a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named AI model/provider found in the public GlobalLink materials, Knowledge Center/blog or privacy/security policy. No public AI/security FAQ or subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/security policy names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS; other trade/logistics credentials are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile explicitly reports no funding; Mohawk describes itself as family-owned and operated. No round date or amount is reported.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding is reported, including for the requested 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive (International Freight Forwarding) listing was readable; the board also lists Account Executive (3PL / Domestic Transportation) openings.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch announcement found for 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. The December 4, 2025 MGCX expansion announcement predates the window. The August 26, 2026 GlobalLink case study describes a customer-specific implementation, not a dated new product or general feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Senior Vice President Jeff Parker announced his retirement on March 30, 2026, within the requested window; his profile headline still retains the former role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The job description mentions an unnamed contact-management database, not a named CRM. A bare Salesforce Test 2 page was also found, but it does not establish a deployed system.
